what: wasm bytes og-anim adds to a cdylib that already links og-core and og-ecs, and the walker world hash on every target
method: a probe cdylib outside the workspace (path deps on og-core, og-ecs, og-anim of the working tree; the workspace Cargo.lock; release opt-level 3, thin LTO, codegen-units 1) exporting run(ticks): base steps an og-ecs world, snapshots and restores; anim also installs og.anim and runs crates/og-anim/tests/support/walk.rs (20 walkers: graph state machine + additive layer, cross-fading players, planar root motion, blendshapes, 60 IK chains), snapshots and restores, returns world_hash. cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown [--features anim]; wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int; brotli -q 11 (the physics measurement's pipeline, without wasm-bindgen)
note_on_size: the delta includes the test driver system and the procedural rig (a few KB); og-anim itself has no dependencies beyond og-core, og-ecs and glam
